edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the recipient address to _safeMint inside mintCryptoKaijus.
msg.sender is passed as the recipient address to _safeMint inside presaleMintCryptoKaijus.
onlyOwner modifier compares owner() against _msgSender(), gating the withdrawal of contract funds.
onlyOwner check on _msgSender() gates emergency setting of the randomness seed block.
setStartingIndex is unpermissioned: any msg.sender can finalize the starting index when conditions are met.
REVEAL_TIMESTAMP is compared against block.timestamp to gate metadata reveal; miner-controllable time dependency.
Constructor initializes REVEAL_TIMESTAMP as block.timestamp plus three days.
tokenURI branches on block.timestamp >= REVEAL_TIMESTAMP to switch between prereveal and revealed metadata.
block.timestamp >= REVEAL_TIMESTAMP determines whether startingIndexBlock gets set during mint.
startingIndexBlock is read and hashed to derive the starting index.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock writes the startingIndexBlock used later as entropy.
startingIndexBlock is consumed by the blockhash entropy source.
startingIndex offsets the token ID when composing the revealed URI.
startingIndex is written from blockhash-derived value inside setStartingIndex.
require(startingIndex == 0) guards the emergency seed setter.
